# HEM v0.7.4b9 — Clear quiet controls and translated fan settings

- Removes redundant unprefixed quiet controls from the full device settings dialog when corresponding controls for the device's operating modes are available. This covers quiet during sleep, quiet when occupied, named quiet fan speeds and percentage speed limits.
- Applies the correction to supported air conditioners, heat pumps, dehumidifiers, humidifiers, fans, extractors and purifiers according to their actual fan-control capabilities. Separate heating, cooling, drying, humidifying and fan-only settings remain independently editable.
- Preserves existing automation entity IDs and stored preferences. A usable older control remains available when all corresponding mode controls are unavailable, and unsaved or failed edits stay visible.
- Fixes fan mode, swing mode and horizontal swing mode labels in all 38 supported languages using the existing translation catalog. Labels follow the Home Assistant server language and the card viewer's language on their respective surfaces; native device option values retain their exact spelling.
- Adds regression coverage for device types, operating modes, percentage and named fan speeds, controller ownership, availability, pending edits, localized entity names and native option writes.

Update through HACS with beta versions enabled, restart Home Assistant to load the integration, and reload the dashboard.
